閉回路呼吸器

A self-contained device that provides breathable air in hazardous or smoke-filled environments, preventing the inhalation of toxic gases.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 閉回路呼吸器?

In this glossary, 閉回路呼吸器 refers to: A self-contained device that provides breathable air in hazardous or smoke-filled environments, preventing the inhalation of toxic gases.

How is 閉回路呼吸器 used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "消火班、煙の充満した区画に入る前に閉回路呼吸器を着装し、マスクの密閉性を確認せよ。"

閉回路呼吸器 matters because it supports clear communication in Emergency Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Definition

A self-contained device that provides breathable air in hazardous or smoke-filled environments, preventing the inhalation of toxic gases.

Operational example

Fire party, don closed breathing apparatus before entering smoke-filled compartments and check facepiece seal for secure fit.

Localized term

閉回路呼吸器

Localized example
